items.name: Free trial
items.description: A 14-day Studio Pro trial is approved but not active yet. Renewal requires explicit consent and a verified payment setup.

items.name: Studio
items.description: The current artist workspace is free. Account access and current private preparation tools do not require a paid subscription.

items.name: Studio Pro
items.description: €12 per month or €120 per year in EUR. Pricing is approved; payment collection, paid feature entitlements and checkout activation are still being verified.

comparison.caption: Studio plans and approved pricing
comparison.scopeNotice: Studio is free. Studio Pro pricing is approved in EUR; checkout and trials are not active yet. Subscriptions are separate from label partnerships and artist payouts. Taxes and final billing details must be shown before purchase.

rows.label: Monthly price
rows.details: The approved Studio Pro price is €12 per month in EUR. Studio remains free. The 14-day Pro trial and paid subscription are not active subscriptions yet: no payment or automatic renewal is enabled until secure checkout is verified. Renewal requires explicit consent.

rows.label: Annual price
rows.details: Studio Pro annual billing is €120 for a full year, equivalent to €10 per month. Annual billing, the trial and renewal remain unavailable until checkout is verified. Any applicable taxes and the amount due must be disclosed before the customer confirms a purchase.

rows.label: Profile and release preparation
rows.details: Current Studio tools support account access, artist-profile management, field visibility and private release preparation. An approved username and explicit publication choice are required for a public profile. Saving a release draft does not distribute music. No existing feature is being removed or silently reassigned to a paid plan.

rows.label: Store preparation
rows.details: Studio supports private store preparation. Shared public shops, checkout, orders, domain connection and financial reporting remain gated. A Studio Pro subscription will not by itself establish merchant eligibility, a commerce agreement or permission to sell until the relevant services and policies are operational.

rows.label: Payment and renewal
rows.details: Subscription billing is distinct from artist earnings and withdrawals. Payment details must be collected by secure provider-hosted fields inside Studio, not ordinary application fields or public records. Automatic renewal requires explicit consent. No card collection, charge, renewal or trial-to-paid conversion is active yet.

rows.label: Partnership and artist payouts
rows.details: Silver, Gold and Platinum describe a separately reviewed label relationship. Paying for Studio Pro must not approve an artist, grant a verification badge, change recording or commerce shares, or enable withdrawals. Payout setup requires its own application, review and provider-verification evidence.
